risks.risk: Model/series is not fully readable, so the exact specs (number of keys, sound engine, power adapter requirements) may differ and affect value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back/bottom panel) and the full front panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha electronic keyboard of unknown model/age (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: “Perfectly working” may be false (some keys, speakers, or buttons may be faulty). Photos can’t confirm full functionality.
risks.proof: Short video: play a scale across the full keyboard, show volume control, demonstrate speaker output, and show at least 2-3 function buttons working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (worst-case: assume possible minor faults until tested).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand) could reduce usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (adapter, pedals, cables) and a shot of the keyboard’s ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the keyboard is included (worst-case for missing accessories).

risks.risk: Power/connection issue (wrong adapter voltage or intermittent power) not detectable from still images.
risks.proof: Video showing it powers on from the provided adapter and stays on while playing for 2–3 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if power reliability is uncertain until proven.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the model/serial label on the back or bottom (so we can price the exact Yamaha model).
Video test: play across all keys + show speaker sound + demonstrate volume and a few buttons.
Photo of included items (power adapter, any pedals/cables) and a shot of the ports.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Yamaha electronic keyboard, but the exact model isn’t readable and “perfectly working” isn’t proven with a functional test video—both are decisive for a safe used price.
